Interface Snapshotable

All Known Implementing Classes:
GameManager, RestoredGameManager
public interface Snapshotable
Marks a class as capable of serializing its current state into a GameSnapshot.

Implemented by GameManager, which is the entry point for capturing the full game state when the server needs to persist a match.
